spec.name: Quiet names v32
spec.notes: Long the calm names, short the jumpy ones.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.0, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 5%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy relies on a full-sample backtest without a dedicated out-of-sample validation period, which risks overfitting to historical noise. Furthermore, the research log indicates a very small number of trials (n=2), suggesting the strategy has not been rigorously stress-tested against alternative parameterizations or market regimes. While the performance metrics appear stable, the lack of a robust research process and the absence of out-of-sample verification make it unsuitable for immediate deployment with real capital. I recommend moving this to a paper trading environment to observe performance in live market conditions before committing any capital.
